sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel away to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach have built a strong foundation this season with seven wins and one draw alongside their two defeats. Alsager Town sit bottom with just four points and have won only one of their ten games, making this a winnable fixture for the league leaders as they look to bounce back.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, seeking to close the one-point gap to Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth welcome fellow mid-table side Eccleshall in a clash between two in-form teams—Bridgnorth have won four of their last five, while Eccleshall recovered from their latest loss to climb to fifth. Wolverhampton Casuals, currently fourth and in good form, face Wednesfield Community at home before hosting Brereton Social on Wednesday evening in a midweek fixture. Bilston Town (sixth, five points behind the leaders) travel to Foley Meir in an intriguing mid-table encounter. At the foot of the table, Widnes Town visit Brereton Social on Saturday in a battle between struggling sides; Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town in another basement clash; and Crewe host Allscott Heath as both teams fight against relegation. Market Drayton Town entertain New Mills, Shawbury United host Barnton, and these fixtures will test whether any lower-table sides can find traction. The headline battle at the top remains between Sandbach's pursuit of consistency and Stafford Town's attempt to mount a title challenge, though Wolverhampton Casuals and AFC Bridgnorth's recent form suggests the race remains competitive.
